subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every month, the school counselor placed a blue envelope in each classroom.”?
options: Some people write to their future selves.
Now students write many kinds of messages.
Some students wanted to write long messages.
They did not have to write their names.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some people write to their future selves.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Now students write many kinds of messages.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some students wanted to write long messages.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They did not have to write their names.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They did not have to write their names.」，答案為「They did not have to write their names.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They did not have to write their names.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
